question: How many orders has each customer placed?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total amount spent by each customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which products cost more than 100?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price, category FROM products WHERE price > 100 ORDER BY price DESC;

question: How many orders were placed in January 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-02-01';

question: What is the average price of products in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY average_price DESC;

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many products are available in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: Which customers have placed more than one order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1;

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

question: Which orders were placed after January 31, 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, total FROM orders WHERE order_date > '2026-01-31' ORDER BY order_date;

question: What is the total revenue generated by each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Which products have never been ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.item_id IS NULL;

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) AS average_order_value FROM orders;

question: How many customers have placed at least one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders;

question: Which products have a price between 20 and 200?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 20 AND 200 ORDER BY price;

question: How many orders were placed in February 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND order_date < '2026-03-01';

question: Which customers spent more than 500 in total?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.total) > 500;

question: What is the total number of units sold across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM order_items;

question: Which customers purchased Electronics products?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the number of orders placed by each customer in February 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Which order has the highest total amount?
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, total FROM orders ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total revenue from orders placed by each customer in January 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: How many order items are included in each order?
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(oi.item_id) AS item_count FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

question: What is the total amount of money spent on each product category?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_spent FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
